title: NPDev UI Contract bundle response
description: GET /api/v1/runtime/metadata/ui/bundle response shape (docs/UI_CONTRACT.md). One copy only -- unlike model.schema.json's 4-way mirror, this shape is produced entirely at runtime by PermissionAwareUiMetadataService.bundle() and is never read by the DSL/compiler, so there is nothing to keep in sync across modules.

modelHash.description: SchemaLifecycleExecutor's own schema fingerprint, reused verbatim (see RuntimeMetadataService#schemaFingerprint). Covers table/column/type/required/unique shape only.

permissionAware.description: Always true. Signals that fields/actions are role-filtered -- NOT that every array in this response is.

scope.description: Empty object when the request supplied neither ?concept= nor ?panel=.

concept.description: The resolved concept object when ?concept= was supplied; null otherwise (including when only ?panel= was supplied -- a panel is not a concept).

fields.description: Permission-filtered. Each item's shape mirrors npdev/metadata/fields.manifest.json plus permissionState/visible/editable.

layout.description: Unfiltered pass-through of the layout catalog.

enums.description: Unfiltered pass-through of the enums catalog.

references.description: Unfiltered pass-through of the references catalog.

actions.description: Permission-filtered. Each item's shape mirrors npdev/metadata/actions.manifest.json plus requiredPermission/available/uiState/denial.

transitions.description: Unfiltered pass-through of the transitions (lifecycle state-machine) catalog.

validation.description: Unfiltered pass-through of the validationHints catalog.

invocations.description: Unfiltered pass-through of the invocations catalog (F2.1) -- method/path/preferred/prefer/execution semantics for every real way to read or mutate this scope.
